title: Monthly Budget Review: Summary for Fiscal Year 2026
summary_raw: In fiscal year 2026, which ended on September 30, the federal budget deficit totaled $2.0 trillion—an increase of $217 billion (or 12 percent) from the deficit recorded in the previous year.
